object.description: Setup: strap worn, session recording; a screen recording of the Active screen is available. Steps: 1. Run 5 min at a steady rate, then 1 min with the strap off. 2. Pause for 1 min while the heart rate changes. 3. Finish and open the workout. 4. From the recording, compute the mean of the bpm values shown during recording-state time, weighting each value by its display duration. Expected: The workout's average heart rate is within 1 bpm of the computed mean; neither the strap-off minute nor the paused minute changes it; maximum equals the highest bpm shown while recording. The 5 s cap is verified by PACE-STS-82.
